The lighting is bright and even across all shots.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal male voice posing a question in a rhythmic manner, accompanied by a steady, 120 BPM electronic drum beat and physical hand claps. (2) Rhythmic hand-clapping sounds continue as two female voices take turns answering the beat-driven game. Their voices are high-pitched and full of excitement. (3) A sudden cartoonish popping SFX occurs, followed by a chorus of spontaneous laughter from several people. (4) The host's voice returns with a new prompt, maintaining the rhythmic structure. The BGM remains consistent with a bouncy, percussive quality. (5) Another round features two male participants whose voices are slightly lower but equally energetic. A 'Ding' sound effect punctuates a successful answer. (6) Throughout the track, short meme-style sound bites and exaggerated vocal reactions (shouts, gasps) are layered over the linear rhythmic structure. The transitions between voices are quick and tightly edited to the beat. (7) The recording ends with a final burst of high-pitched laughter and a celebratory vocal stinger from the host.
